notes.notes:
This patch fixes bugs:

notes.title: Bugfix #12
notes.notes:
A rather annoying bug that resulted in temporary or permanent displacement or even disappering of UI elements ingame has been fixed in this patch.

notes.title: Update 1.7 is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Server 2.0[/h1]
We have created a new and improved server for the game.
This will allow us to easily expand it in the future, as well as add new features.

[h1]New Visuals![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/ead77af113bfa79d44b67d70c91bca8baf625c2b.png[/img]
We've overhauled the old trees and made some that are even better!

[h1]Deck Editor[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/11ffac61625823797e9982f0e6ca36e5a8bfbab7.png[/img]
The deck editor has been changed due to user requests.
It now supports multiple deck layouts and is much easier to use.

[h1]Updated in-game UI[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/25031a20216b3a0be91c95f247c737f5f31bd0b0.png[/img]
The old blueprint system has been removed from the game and has been substituted by a new system.
This new system allows you to view unit information mid-game and easily manage your army!

notes.title: User Interface Flow
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Introduction[/h2][/b]
The previous UI flow was too slow and had a lot of unnecessary information.
This would often confuse players and could be seen as frustrating.
That's why we thought it was about time we changed it.


[b][h2]Explanation[/h2][/b]
The new flow goes as follows :

[b]First[/b], you click on a unit or crystal that you want to interact with.
You can either just click or hold down the mouse button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/4e9bd426b02ed9097fe739f7e893f868b9c587f8.gif[/img]


[b]Next[/b], you click or drag towards the action you want to preform.
This action will then be selected.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/af33e0cda946af8f5ebf9b5b4d325081f253df3b.gif[/img]


[b]At last[/b], if the action you choose needs a position you will need to click on a position.
Or if you're still dragging, you have to release the mouse button on the position.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/5c6d7a784f9a5ccedc23c0fef091a1e2e33ce735.gif[/img]


[b][h2]Conclusion[/h2][/b]
This new way of interacting with the units and crystal is much faster and feels more fluent.
We hope you all enjoy this new flow :D

notes.title: Main Menu Overhaul
notes.notes:
The original main menu was made with mobile devices in mind.
But after a while, we noticed it would be better to make a separate menu just for the pc.

So that's why we dedicated this update to making a brand new main menu. 

Here's a comparison of the old and new menu, with the old one on top.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/74a9ec2ce4236926cd886a8ebb0e7edf4469da82.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/952040a8d525bc852e0fda36b324bfb7b2a9b63b.png[/img]

The new main menu has a bunch of cool new features too like :
- Match history
- Ability to store multiple decks
- Colored unit outlines

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/bcfcbb8d96ac83753205e29d15e181a60f72c203.png[/img]

Besides these main points are is lots more to explore.
So make sure you check out the new menu.

We wish you a lot of fun with this new menu!

notes.title: Golden Crystal Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/eeedc7b1c3440239c4586a07685dd337e4506eff.png[/img]

We saw that matches were taking too long.
So we added a brand new feature which gets activated when a match takes more then 30 turns.

A [b]golden crystal[/b] will appear ontop of the center crystal!
The first player to capture this golden crystal will win the match.

This way people are more preasured to win before the [b]30 turn counter[/b] ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567190/73c1ca40828267740b53ae01d403db2145fe1764.png[/img]

We hope this will makes the game more fun.
And more enjoyable as a quick game you can play inside your breaks.
